categories.main_business_segments: Yunnan Botanee Bio-Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the daily chemical products manufacturing industry, focusing on cosmetics manufacturing with key segments including skincare products, medical devices, and makeup. The company develops and sells professional skincare products targeting sensitive skin, medical skin care devices, and makeup products under multiple brands such as Winona, Winona Baby, AOXMED, Beforteen, Za, and PURE&MILD.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes the use of pure natural plant active ingredients combined with dermatological science, biology, and botany for product development. It employs industrialized production methods including self-production, entrusted processing, and finished product procurement. The company has established advanced R&D centers and laboratories in China, Japan, and France, focusing on innovative formulations, clinical efficacy verification, and patented technologies. It also uses AI for personalized acne treatment solutions and has developed specialized medical devices for skin barrier protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves consumers with sensitive skin, infants and children with skin conditions, and users seeking anti-aging and acne treatment products. Its products target the Chinese domestic market predominantly, with growing presence in Southeast Asia including Thailand and Taiwan. Customers include end consumers via online and offline retail channels, medical institutions, and professional dermatology clinics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China with extensive sales and distribution networks covering major cities and regions. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shanghai, Kunming, Chengdu, Guangzhou, and other Chinese cities. Internationally, it has expanded into Southeast Asia markets such as Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Vietnam, Japan, Hong Kong, and the USA.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunnan Botanee operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product R&D, manufacturing, and sales. It manages its own production facilities and also uses entrusted processing and finished product procurement. The company maintains a comprehensive supply chain system including raw material procurement, production planning, and logistics distribution to ensure product quality and supply reliability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on building a leading sensitive skin care ecosystem through continuous R&D innovation, brand upgrading, and product line expansion. It emphasizes scientific research on skin mechanisms, development of proprietary plant-based active ingredients, and clinical validation. The company invests in global research collaborations, AI-driven personalized skincare solutions, and medical device innovation. It also prioritizes digital transformation, supply chain digitization, and sustainable green development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales across multiple channels including online self-operated stores, third-party e-commerce platforms, offline direct sales, and distribution partnerships. The company uses a combination of direct sales, consignment, and distribution models. It also earns income from medical device sales and related services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, with consideration of return policies and sales commissions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic brand in the sensitive skin care and dermatological cosmetics market in China, holding top market shares in its core segments. It competes with both domestic and international cosmetics brands, leveraging its scientific research capabilities, specialized product offerings, and integrated online-offline sales channels. Its Winona brand is recognized as a market leader in skin science-based skincare products for sensitive skin.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.74 billion, representing a 3.87% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 503 million, a decline of 33.53% compared to the previous year, impacted by increased marketing expenses and market competition. The company’s total assets reached RMB 8.3 billion, with steady growth in asset base and cash flow from operations. It maintains a strong market presence with diversified brand portfolio and expanding sales channels.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunnan Botanee emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing professional, effective, and safe skincare solutions based on pure natural plant actives and dermatological science, specifically targeting sensitive skin. Its products are clinically validated and supported by extensive R&D and patented technologies. The company differentiates itself through a multi-brand strategy addressing diverse consumer needs, integration of AI for personalized treatment, and a robust OMO (online-merge-offline) sales model that enhances consumer experience and loyalty.
